title: Change a 54 mm portafilter from one cup to two
instruction: Remove the one-cup basket using the service lever. Install the two-cup basket evenly in the portafilter and release it.
context: Changing recipes changes the basket. A low lever lifts the nested one-cup basket out of a cold bottomless portafilter so the robot can grip its rim. The new basket seats on the original rim.
setup: Cold 54 mm-class bottomless portafilter on a 280 × 114 mm bench cradle with a pivoted ejector. The modeled stainless baskets are 24 mm and 29 mm deep. The single basket starts seated in the portafilter, the double basket is loose at (229, −225, 31) mm, and the 83 × 81 mm discard tray is centered at (253, 193, 0) mm. Coordinates use the tabletop as Z zero.
scoring: 0.15 after the lever moves downward beyond 8.6° while the original rim rises more than 4.5 mm. 0.35 with the old basket released within 25 mm of the discard tray center and its rim 23–39 mm above the table. 0.65 with the double basket centered within 3.6 mm horizontally and 3.2 mm vertically at the seat with tilt under 8.2°. Full credit after a continuous second with the lever no more than 2.6° below its upright pose, the old basket still in the tray, and both baskets and lever released with the new basket still.
reset_notes: Reinstall the one-cup basket, reset lever upright, return the double basket to its start and clear tray.
fidelity: Breville-compatible 54 mm basket class and bottomless head use a disclosed custom ejection cradle. Rigid contacts measure lifting and rim seating. Retention spring force is not calibrated and this task makes no claim about espresso extraction.
